title: How Outdoor Kitchen Store Launched Its First Storefront on Shopware
excerpt: Case study we wrote for Shopware. Covers how outdoor-cooking retailer Outdoor Kitchen Store went from offline-only to its first ecommerce storefront on Shopware 6 with agency GoWide Solutions.
content: Content Cucumber wrote this customer case study for Shopware. We interviewed Outdoor Kitchen Store and GoWide Solutions (the implementation agency), gathered the technical and operational details, and structured the narrative around the retailer's move from an offline-only business to its first ecommerce storefront on Shopware 6.
challenge:
Shopware needed a customer case study showing how Outdoor Kitchen Store, a retailer of grills and outdoor kitchens that had run entirely on showrooms and warehouses, stood up its first ecommerce storefront on Shopware 6. The story had to translate an operationally heavy build (custom warehouse management, QuickBooks accounting, multi-warehouse fulfillment, tax and shipping logic) into a clear, prospect-facing narrative.

It had to work for two audiences at once: traditional retailers going online for the first time, and Shopware's own sales team using it as proof that Shopware handles real operational complexity, not just a storefront.
approach:
We interviewed Outdoor Kitchen Store and GoWide Solutions (the implementation agency partner) to gather the technical and operational details.

From the source material we structured the narrative around the opportunity new ownership saw (a reputable offline business with no online store), the requirement that the software fit the business rather than the reverse, and the outcomes. We surfaced the details that mattered (a custom warehouse-management plugin with automated warehouse-specific order routing, a custom QuickBooks integration built because no marketplace extension supported Shopware 6.6, Avalara tax automation, postal-code shipping restrictions, and a full catalog migration handled with custom Python tooling). We also noted why the team chose Shopware over Salesforce: the same functionality at a more cost-effective implementation.

Delivered as a polished case study ready for Shopware's content library and sales enablement.
results: Written for Shopware's customer library. It tells how Outdoor Kitchen Store launched its first ecommerce storefront on Shopware 6.6.10.4 with GoWide Solutions, unifying online sales, multi-warehouse inventory, a custom QuickBooks integration, Avalara tax automation, BlueSnap payments, Affirm financing, and postal-code shipping rules in one connected platform, with the full existing catalog migrated via custom Python tooling and a GitHub and DeployHQ CI/CD pipeline for future growth.
quote: Previously, the client was focused entirely on offline marketing. They didn't have an online store where customers could browse or purchase products.

The piece covers how the outdoor-cooking retailer launched its first ecommerce storefront on Shopware 6.6.10.4, with custom warehouse management, a custom QuickBooks integration, Avalara tax automation, BlueSnap payments, Affirm financing, and postal-code shipping rules, choosing Shopware over Salesforce on cost and flexibility. Shopware is the client. Outdoor Kitchen Store is the customer featured in the story.
